meta.notes: THE TIER A RULES (the Atomic World Lab fixture, lab-2): the L1 material loop as PACK DATA over the landed primitives. The three halves: THE SOURCES' REGENERATION (economy.flows — four ungated environmental mints at the year clock, the 02 §9 preferred form, no capacity cap by honest residue); THE ROUNDS (urgencies — the twelve adults' work cycles, each round a chain of one-hop moves + one material verb, every entry's (intent, requires) pair unique under the AP-11 clone law: the loaded-return gates carry each round's own kind signature, the daughters' idles their own lengths, the talk cycle its own directed targets); THE MEAL'S REPLY (on_action — the serve events' witnesses feel the fatigue ease, the loop's closing edge, the co-location race the settlement's attendance). The crime_watch key is the dormant scaffold (the required key, empty mappings its legal minimum — this fixture carries no crime line). The optional families (weather, echo, traits, reflection, secrets, factions, retrieval, scene_detail, expectations, worldgen, names, cultures, travel) stay UNARMED — the fixture's honest minimalism; the arming law (68a) owns each. Every value is v0.1 tunable pack data, never law (INV-3).
meta.display: Farstead — the Tier A world (the Atomic World Lab fixture)

time.notes: MVP_SCOPE §8's day; the macro year at 360 days (the engine's standing shape). THE LOD LAW'S CADENCE SIDE: under the armed macro clock the beats run per-day for the ACTIVE location alone and the warm ring rolls once a year at the crossings — the Tier A world's material cycle is therefore a YEAR-CLOCKED thing wherever the workers stand beyond the anchor's room. The horizon arithmetic the Lab reads: 10y = 5,184,000 ticks, 100y = 51,840,000.

states.notes: THE COMPOSITE BODY DEFICIT (the engine's one growing axis, named for the gain law's hardcoded key): hunger, thirst and weariness ride one number — the fixture's need gauge. It climbs ~40 a day and eases ONLY at the meal's reply (on_action, −40 for the witnesses); at the LOD's year cadence it pins at the ceiling between rare serves — THE PIN ITSELF THE DATUM (the daily-scale need axes against the year-scale world: the mismatch measured, not hidden). No decay: between the pin and the meal there is nothing that sheds the deficit for free.

relations.notes: two axes, the standing minimal shape: TRUST is the settlement's whole social surface (the talk gate reads it; the households' pair bonds seed it); SUSPICION is the dormant crime scaffold's own home (the reaction door reads the axis unconditionally when the block is armed — this fixture's crime line is empty, the axis stands unwritten and unread).

checks.notes: the minimal check surface: no material verb in this fixture rolls (the haul, the fell, the draw are labor, never contests — the pressure precedent's law); the social check stands for the green's talk, the pursuit family for the dormant scaffold.

knowledge.notes: EVENT_SCHEMA §3's family, the fixture's tuning: the teller penalty reads FATIGUE (the hollow-cheeked teller mumbles — the tired settlement retells its own news badly, the pressure pack's cold-teller precedent moved onto the one axis this world carries). The green's oral memory is the fixture's whole knowledge transmission: what the daughters hear, the households repeat.

crime_watch.notes: THE DORMANT SCAFFOLD (the engine's hard requirements, honestly declared): this fixture carries no crime line at all (the empty mapping returns before any suspicion move; no rotations; no sources) — nothing here ever fires. The settlement's order is a hearth and a store table, not a patrol.

position_visibility.notes: the node model, unchanged: the star's spokes are one hop each, sight never passes through exits, the anvil's ring heard vague one hop out (the green hears the workshop's hammer).

systems.notes: the pass DAG, fixture-shaped: the five engine rows in their standing shape + HEARTH (this pack's own material family — the account verbs and the meal's reply; event-driven, never a per-tick pass) + the dormant scaffold's two rows. No per-tick system exists (no transition layers, no fire family) — the whole world moves on intents, beats and the year clock.

metrics.notes: M1's cross-system share, fixture-shaped: the HEARTH column is the L1 family's own attribution — every account verb and the meal's reply touch it (a gather, a deposit and a meal are all HEARTH events; the difference is which ledger they move — the pressure pack's M1 signature, moved from its thermal family onto the material one). The regrowth flows (account_sourced) sit beneath the tale's gate by the importance rule — the environment's hum, never the story.

importance.notes: THE TALE'S BEATS — the fixture's split from the committed packs: the MATERIAL TRANSITS are the story here (every settle, transfer and consume is a tale line; the meal's reply a medium beat) — in a world whose whole point is the material loop, the loop IS the chronicle. The environment's hum (the regrowth flows, account_sourced) stays LOW — four lines a year of 'the bank regrows' would bury the tale; the decay drift and the base verbs stay low with it (tune-1's law, the boundary moved where this pack's signal lives).

economy.notes: THE SOURCES' REGENERATION (the L1 supply edge, 02 §9's preferred form): four environmental mints at the year clock, each into an EXISTING source's stock — never a bare spawn, always an environmental process changing a declared source's capacity. THE HONEST GAPS, declared not hidden: (1) NO CAPACITY — the flows mint unconditionally, an unharvested source accumulates without bound (the bounded-source primitive does not exist; the regrowth numbers are tuned small enough that the harvest pressure dominates at these cadences, and the accumulation curve itself is a measured read); (2) NO DRAIN ARM — the flows are pure mints, the depletion edge rides the extraction verbs' settle legs alone. The prices are derived reads (the scarcity dial, D-119's law: never stored, never a transaction — the future trade arm's standing surface).

director.notes: the minimal armed shape: the stagnation floor stands (the loop's policy reads it unconditionally), and nothing else is declared — no hooks, no arcs, no channels: the director holds an empty buffer by construction and releases nothing. THE LAB'S OWN LAW (the pack's 03 §3: player-absent = no plot injection) — the fixture's world pressure is the material cycle's own, never the planner's.

account_consumed.notes: THE MEAL'S REPLY (the L1 loop's closing edge): everyone who witnessed a served meal or pail — the keeper herself and every soul standing on the green that moment — feels the body deficit ease by forty. THE CO-LOCATION RACE IS THE SETTLEMENT'S ATTENDANCE, measured: the straggler at the far copse misses supper and the log shows it (his fatigue keeps climbing, the decay pass writes it). One hop, no knowledge of its own — the cascade terminates by construction.

on_action.notes: the world's replies, fixture-minimal: ONE family — the meal's. The material verbs need no social replies (a deposit is its own fact); the need axis's only writer beside the drift is this reply.

entries.notes: THE FOOD POST, THE HAUL: certain at the yearly crossing (the warm bank rolls once a year) -- two food, bank to green's store, one event.
THE MEAL ROUND, THE REFILL: thin by design -- the float's refill draws the pair from the store when both corners hold.
THE MEAL ROUND, THE MEAL: a food off the float and out of the world, the green and the ring eased -- the loop's closing edge.
THE MEAL ROUND, THE PAIL: the water's own sink, the same witnesses, the same reply.
THE WATER POST, THE HAUL: certain at the yearly crossing -- two water, basin to store, the pail at his feet.
THE GREEN'S FIRST VOICE: her talk round the daughters' directed cycle (Ashen to Bourne to Crome to Ashen -- every target unique under the clone law), the telling pair the settlement's oral memory.
THE TIMBER POST, THE HAUL: certain at the yearly crossing -- two lengths, copse to wood corner.
THE ORE POST, THE HAUL: certain at the yearly crossing -- two bloom, face to ore corner, the scarcest stream's edge.

THE ROAD-WATCH, THE TALK: the boy chats at whoever stands on the road -- in the player-absent runs, the silent surveyor himself (the world acknowledging the observer without authorship; the telling pair rides it, the settlement's first news of the stranger).
THE GREEN'S SECOND VOICE: her edge of the daughters' directed cycle -- the smiths' news through the cutters' house.

THE ANVIL POST, THE FORGE: certain at the yearly crossing while the rack holds and the bench is fed -- at these cadences the rack (six tools, one a year, no producer) empties inside the first decade and this goes silent at the door: the tool arm's death a measured curve in the log, the conversion gap's own face.
THE BENCH'S ORE ARM: certain at the yearly crossing when the green's ore corner holds -- two bloom, store to bench, the spoke carrying the goods to the workshop side.

THE BENCH'S WOOD ARM: the green-liver rolls at the ACTIVE square's beats -- thin (probability 1) because the active zone's beat rolls herd under the one-wait protocol (every passing roll enqueues for the wait's end); the wood corner's arrivals pace him.
THE GREEN'S THIRD VOICE: her edge of the directed cycle -- the foragers' news through the smiths' house, the cycle closed.

urgencies.notes: THE TWELVE ADULTS' ROUNDS (the autonomous engine's whole fixture surface -- 14 entries, every (intent, requires) pair unique across NPCs under the AP-11 clone law, and every (npc, kind) pair unique per NPC under the one-goal-per-verb law the engine's content-addressed roll streams demand). THE HAUNT MODEL + THE DIRECT HAUL (every post resident from the founding -- the road-boy included; the pack carries NO move entry at all), declared not hidden: the substrate offers NO commuter form (a move entry has one fixed target, one goal per verb per NPC) and NO chainable round (the second verb's gate reads the pre-first state -- and under the one-wait E0 protocol every urgency intent DEFERS to the wait's end, the temp-1 law, so a chained second link never rolls); the honest shape is the resident post with a DIRECT settle -- source to store in one event, the hauler the doer. THE CADENCE TRUTH: the posts sit in the warm ring (yearly rolls, probability 100 = one certain haul a year), the green's voices at the active square's beats (probability 1 -- the active zone's rolls herd under the one-wait protocol, so the thin roll keeps the herd signal-sized). The E0 reads the cycle at the year clock: the material loop CLOSES, slowly -- the cadence is the LOD's own law and the protocol's own law, never a tuning failure (the anchor-pair battery measures both directly). The player is exempt (the surveyor authors nothing).

present_entities.notes: THE GRANARY LINE (the fixture's one read surface): the green's scene line carries the LIVE food stock (the anchor field's legality, the pressure pack's gauge precedent — the fold-outranks-record law renders the standing number, integer truth below, one rendered line above). THE NEED MARKER: the hollow-cheeked flag at fatigue 70+ — the pin made visible on the card (between the rare meals, most of the settlement wears it at the year cadence; the marker's spread IS the famine gauge).

Facts are immutable; prose is yours.
Never invent events, names, or outcomes.

lore.text: Farstead is three households around one green: the Ashens who forage, the Bournes who cut and break, the Cromes who work the anvil. Everything the settlement owns sits on the green or in the ground around it.
The store on the green is the settlement's whole buffer: what the rounds bring in, the hearth draws out, and when the corners stand empty the green goes quiet and the people go hollow.
The smith's rack held six tools at the founding, and no craft since has made a seventh: the anvil moves them off one at a time, and when the rack stands empty the hammer falls silent for good.

voice_exemplars: The green kept its count: food in the corner, wood in the stack, the ore waiting for the bench.
A meal passed on the green, and for a while the hollows eased.
brief.notes: BRIEF_SPEC §6's standing shape, fixture-filled: the lore carries the three truths (the households, the store's law, the rack's finitude — the conversion gap told as the settlement's own memory); the voice is a granary's patient arithmetic.
